learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected London as unreachable by ISS and locked it in. Initial tilt30 degrees placed all cities out of reach.
observations.exploration: ISS tilt51.6 gave Rome and London in reach, Moscow out. Slider56 made all three in reach and unlocked reveal. Polar90 reached90 north/south, all cities remained in reach.
observations.reveal: Corrected Moscow; circular inclination51.6 bounds latitude to51.6 north/south, London51.5 inside, Moscow55.8 outside, needed near56. Distinguishes latitude reach from overflight on a specific day, which depends on timing.
observations.visual: Inline screenshot inspected at56: blue three-lap sinusoidal ground tracks, dashed northern/southern limits, all city dots green and statuses in reach. Caption idealised circular orbit. Trust7/7 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
